summary: This page compares NTAG213, NTAG215 and NTAG216 for buyers deciding which NTAG memory path best fits simple redirects, branded NFC cards, review taps or larger payload use cases.
Use these short answers to decide whether this page matches the project before moving into the detail.
NTAG213 - Simple redirects and lighter NFC payloads - Efficient default for many tap-to-link projects

faq.question: Is NTAG216 always the safest choice?
faq.answer: Not always. It gives more headroom, but many commercial tap-to-link projects work well on smaller NTAG variants once the payload is defined clearly.

faq.question: What decides the NTAG choice fastest?
faq.answer: The fastest path is to define the payload, redirect model and update workflow first, then choose the smallest realistic chip family that still leaves comfortable headroom.
